title: Death of woman in Kozhikode’s Perambra: Cases filed against those who protested outside bank branch

ai.summary: Police in Kozhikode registered cases against 200 protesters who blocked a road for four hours outside a bank branch, claiming the bank's refusal to grant a five-day grace period for loan repayment led to a woman's death.

facts.claim: Police in Kozhikode registered cases against 200 protesters
facts.quote: The Balussery police in Kozhikode district of Keralam have registered cases against a large number of people who staged a protest outside the Naduvannur branch of a bank on November 16

facts.claim: Protesters blocked the Perambra-Kozhikode road for four hours
facts.quote: The protesters blocked the Perambra-Kozhikode road for around four hours from 10.30 a.m.

facts.claim: Protesters demanded a write-off of the loan and financial compensation
facts.quote: also demanding a write-off of the loan taken by the family and a financial compensation

facts.claim: The woman's death was linked to bank attachment proceedings
facts.quote: The incident occurred around 11 a.m. on November 13 when a team comprising bank officials, an advocate commissioner, and police personnel arrived at her residence to execute court-mandated attachment proceedings

facts.claim: The woman was found hanging after bank officials searched her home
facts.quote: Subsequently, they discovered Kavitha hanging inside an old ancestral house located behind the property

ai.background_note: A woman died after bank officials executed attachment proceedings on her home; protesters claimed the bank's refusal to grant a five-day grace period for loan repayment led to her death.
